title: Winter Thanksgiving Festival (DS)
wikitext:
The '''Winter Thanksgiving Festival''' is a festival in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] and [[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

Similar to the [[Spring Thanksgiving Festival (DS)|Spring Thanksgiving Festival]] that takes place in Spring. Instead of the girls receiving gifts, it is instead a day for boys to receive sweets from girls. Unlike the Spring Festival, chocolate or chocolate cake will be used instead of cookies or chocolate cookies.

==Harvest Moon DS==
Each of the eligible bachelorettes will come to your farmhouse throughout the course of the day, bringing gifts. Any girl who has a purple heart level or higher will take part. Each girl will show up at your doorstep at a different time of the day and will give the player chocolate. A girl with a green heart level or higher will instead give you a chocolate cake. 
*Lumina shows up first, in between 6am and 7am.
*Celia will show up in between 8am and 9am.
*Flora, from 10am until 11am.
*Muffy comes between 12pm and 1pm.
*Muffy, from 2pm until 3pm.
In order to see each girl, you must enter your farmhouse and exit. Each girl will be waiting outside the door and will ask to come in. Talk to them to receive your gift, and afterward, they will leave. If you are married, your wife will put chocolate cake into your rucksack while you are asleep.

==DS Cute==
In ''Cute'', you must give out chocolate or chocolate cake to each of the eligible bachelors. Each guy you give chocolate to will receive a big LP boost.
*Marlin shows up first, in between 6am and 8am.
*Gustafa will show up in between 8am and 10am.
*Rock, from 10am until 12pm.
*Carter comes between 12pm and 1pm.
*Griffin, from 2pm until 3pm.
*Skye arrives last from 4pm until 5pm.
In order to see each boy, you must enter your farmhouse and exit. The bachelor will be waiting outside the door and will ask to come in. Talk to them to give your gift, and afterward, they will leave.
